issue.title: [bug] Responses → Chat for Mistral: `deepseek-*` model gets `reasoning_content` echoed back → 422 extra_forbidden (Codex breaks after first tool call)
issue.body:
## Problem

Follow-up to #494 (fixed in 0.1.616 for the Chat passthrough). The Chat Completions route still works, but the
`/v1/responses → /v1/chat/completions` route (what Codex uses) sends an earlier assistant turn's reasoning to Mistral as
`reasoning_content` when the model name is DeepSeek-like. Mistral rejects it:

```text
Mistral10977752: 422 Unprocessable Entity: {"detail":[{"type":"extra_forbidden","loc":["body","messages",1,"assistant","reasoning_content"],"msg":"Extra inputs are not permitted","input":"I should read note.txt with the tool."}]}
```

In Codex the first request of a turn succeeds; every follow-up after a tool call fails with 422 (repeated, so the
"retry without the rejected field and remember it" fallback from #494 does not kick in on this route either).

## Environment

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Magpie | 0.1.2710 (Windows app) |
| Client | Codex Desktop 0.166.0-alpha.5.1 (`effort: max`) |
| Provider | `mistral` preset, `https://api.mistral.ai/v1` |
| Model | `deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` |

## Reproduction

```sh
curl http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/responses \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer magpie' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"<mistral-provider>/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017","stream":false,"max_output_tokens":40,
       "tools":[{"type":"function","name":"read_file","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string"}}}}],
       "input":[
         {"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"Read note.txt and tell me the word."}]},
         {"type":"reasoning","summary":[{"type":"summary_text","text":"I should read note.txt with the tool."}]},
         {"type":"function_call","call_id":"call_1","name":"read_file","arguments":"{\"path\":\"note.txt\"}"},
         {"type":"function_call_output","call_id":"call_1","output":"pelican"}]}'
```

| Request | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `/v1/responses`, `deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` | **422** extra_forbidden `reasoning_content` |
| `/v1/responses`, `zai-glm-5-3` (same provider) | 200 |
| `/v1/responses`, `mistral-medium-latest` (same provider) | 200 |
| `/v1/chat/completions` with `reasoning_content` on an assistant turn, `deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` | 200 |

So it looks like the DeepSeek "reasoning must be passed back" handling (keyed on the model name) re-adds
`reasoning_content` after the Mistral-specific conversion to a `thinking` content part, on the Responses route only.
Possibly the same name-keyed injection as #3165 / `withReasoningOnToolTurns` in #2607, but here the upstream is
Mistral, which rejects the field outright.

## Expected

For a Mistral upstream (preset or `api.mistral.ai` host), never send `reasoning_content` / `reasoning` /
`reasoning_details` as message fields regardless of the model name, same as the Chat route since 0.1.616.

comments.body:
### Conclusion

Reproduced and fixed the Mistral translation case on Windows/amd64, Go 1.27.0, at `ed978e56` on 2026-11-02. For a Chat request built for Mistral, the final translated body now goes through the existing `mistralThinking` conversion before it is sent.

### Evidence

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Baseline Responses-to-Chat request | 422 `extra_forbidden` at `messages[].reasoning_content` |
| After conversion | 200 |
| Same body after disabling the new branch | 422 again |
| Mistral thinking-part test | pass |
| Translated DeepSeek comparison | pass |

The upstream never received `reasoning_content`, `reasoning`, or `reasoning_details` as message fields in the passing case; the earlier reasoning remains as Mistral's typed `thinking` content part. `gofmt`, Windows/Linux vet, and Windows/Linux/macOS builds passed.

### Boundary

The branch uses the same Mistral predicate as the direct Chat path: preset `mistral` or host `api.mistral.ai`. Other Chat providers keep their existing reasoning replay behavior. The direct Chat path is unchanged and does not run the conversion twice.

### Gap

Not tried: a real Mistral API request. The full gateway suite is not green in this environment, but the failing Windows/WSL and JSON cases reproduce at `ed978e56` without this change.

### Action

A minimal local diff is ready. I can put the 12-line implementation patch here if useful.

**Root cause.** `buildChat` replays an assistant turn's thinking in `reasoning_content` whenever `chatReplaysReasoning` says the upstream wants it back — and that predicate keys on the model **name** ("deepseek" anywhere in it), wherever the model is actually served. So a `deepseek-*` model on Mistral had `reasoning_content` injected on every tool turn of a translated request. The conversion that saves this (`mistralThinking`, from the #494 fix) ran only on the Chat passthrough route, never on a translated build — which is exactly your A/B: `/v1/chat/completions` with `reasoning_content` on the same provider answered 200 (the relay converts the field), while `/v1/responses` 422ed on every follow-up after the first tool call (the translation injects the field and nothing converts it). The "retry without the rejected field" fallback from #494 can't kick in because the field is magpie's own injection on this route, not a client field it could remember.

**Fix** (branch `fix/4906-mistral-translated-reasoning`):

- `forwardTranslated` now runs the same `mistralThinking` conversion on the body built for a Mistral upstream (preset `mistral` or `api.mistral.ai` — the identical gate the relayed route uses), beside the other per-protocol post-build mends: the reasoning fields come out of every message and the thinking goes in as the typed `thinking` part Mistral itself returns it in, ahead of the turn's content.
- Everything else unchanged: other upstreams keep the #1462 replay behavior (a DeepSeek at DeepSeek still gets `reasoning_content`), and the relayed Chat route already had the conversion.

**Verification.**

- `TestTranslatedReasoningAsThinkingForMistral`: your request verbatim (reasoning item → `function_call` → `function_call_output`) on `mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017`. On current `main` the upstream answers your exact 422 — `loc ["body","messages",1,"assistant","reasoning_content"]`, `"Extra inputs are not permitted"`, input `"I should read note.txt with the tool."` (red log recorded); with the fix no message carries `reasoning_content`, and the reasoning item's summary reaches Mistral as a `thinking` part.
- Scope guards: `TestTranslatedToolTurnWithoutReasoning` (DeepSeek elsewhere keeps the replay), `TestChatToolTurnWithoutReasoningNotForMistral` and `TestMistralReasoningAsThinking` (relay unchanged) all pass; `gofmt`/`go vet`/`go build` clean. Doc line added in `docs/subsystems/gateway-routing.md`.

**Branch:** https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/4906-mistral-translated-reasoning (head `29b0ea308`)

**Boundary:** not verified against the real Mistral API — no key here. The refusal and the accepted thinking-part shape are the ones already encoded from #494 (`mistralThinking` and its tests); the red log reproduces your 422 byte for byte in field, location and input. `zai-glm-5-3` and `mistral-medium-latest` never tripped this because their names don't say DeepSeek, so nothing was injected for them.

This is a fork branch, ready for review, not a claim on the issue's ownership.

### Conclusion

I rebuilt and validated the Mistral translation fix on current `origin/main` (`173b7e2742530dc6c9b7cd14f63cbf8eafc79f9c`) and published a complete cherry-pickable patch. A translated Chat body for Mistral now passes through the existing thinking-part conversion before it is sent.

### Evidence

- Branch: https://github.com/Edward4226/magpie/tree/codex/issue-4906-mistral
- Commit: https://github.com/Edward4226/magpie/commit/0b8aee26fefe1e1f3f14dc252237d922da071291
- Patch: https://github.com/Edward4226/magpie/commit/0b8aee26fefe1e1f3f14dc252237d922da071291.patch
- Compare: https://github.com/Edward4226/magpie/compare/173b7e2742530dc6c9b7cd14f63cbf8eafc79f9c...codex/issue-4906-mistral
- `go test -tags nogui ./internal/gateway -run '^TestTranslatedMistralReasoningAsThinking$' -count=1`: pass
- `gofmt`, `git diff --check`, Windows/Linux `go vet`, Windows/Linux/macOS top-level builds: pass

The test includes the DeepSeek-elsewhere control, which still receives `reasoning_content`; Mistral receives a typed `thinking` part instead. This is an independent implementation, interchangeable with skygunner's branch above, not a claim that only this patch works.

### Boundary

The Mistral gate matches the existing direct-Chat gate: preset `mistral` or host `api.mistral.ai`. Other providers and the direct Chat path are unchanged.

### Gap

Not tried: a real Mistral API request; the full gateway suite.

### Action

Cherry-pick `0b8aee26f`, or run:

```sh
git fetch https://github.com/Edward4226/magpie.git codex/issue-4906-mistral
git cherry-pick 0b8aee26fefe1e1f3f14dc252237d922da071291
```

Do not apply both fork branches and skygunner's branch; their behavior is the same. The issue remains open.

Thanks @skygunner for the first complete fix, and @Edward4226 for the independent reproduction and patch.

I tested skygunner's `29b0ea308` on current `main` (`a92cc3f3`), Windows/amd64, Go 1.27.3. It cherry-picks cleanly. **Verified end to end with the real Mistral API and real Codex.**

**Real Codex session.** I built `main` + the fix and ran it as the gateway on my usual port. In Codex Desktop with `mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` (effort max), I sent the same prompt that failed on 0.1.2782 ("draw a pelican riding a bicycle as a single-file SVG/HTML animation"). It ran for 12 minutes with many tool calls and file edits, and finished with no 422 and no reconnects. On 0.1.2782 the same prompt failed after the first tool call: 422 at `messages[2].assistant.reasoning_content`, with real reasoning text this time, not the `" "` placeholder.

**Real Mistral API, through the in-process gateway** (`/v1/responses`, isolated config):

| | turn 1 | turn 2 (function_call + output sent back) | tool turn with no reasoning item |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `main` | 200 | **422** `extra_forbidden` at `messages[1].assistant.reasoning_content` | **422** |
| with fix | 200 | **200** | **200** |

**Raw `/v1/chat/completions` to Mistral**, to see which assistant tool-call message shapes it accepts:

| assistant tool-call message | result |
| --- | --- |
| `reasoning_content: " "` | 422 |
| `reasoning_content: "<text>"` | 422 |
| `content: [thinking part "<text>"]` | 200 |
| `content: [thinking part " "]` (what the fix sends for the placeholder) | 200 |
| field dropped | 200 |

**Unit tests:** `TestTranslatedReasoningAsThinkingForMistral` and an extra no-reasoning-item test both fail with 422 on `main` and pass with the fix. The other Mistral / DeepSeek reasoning tests pass, and so does `go vet`. In the full `./internal/gateway` suite, the same 12 tests fail on `main` without the fix (Windows-specific handover, socket, marshal and root-env tests), so they're unrelated.

Minor nit, not blocking: the placeholder becomes a whitespace-only thinking part. Mistral accepts it, but `strings.TrimSpace(think) == ""` would drop it instead.

Could one of you open a PR so the maintainers can review it?

Fixed in dd2be6565, released in **v0.1.3125**.

On `/v1/responses`, a request translated to a Mistral upstream (preset `mistral` or `api.mistral.ai`) now goes through the same `mistralThinking` conversion the direct Chat route has. An earlier turn's reasoning reaches Mistral as a typed `thinking` part, not `reasoning_content`, so a Codex tool loop on `mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` no longer gets 422 `extra_forbidden` after its first call. A whitespace-only placeholder is now dropped, not sent as a blank thinking part (MystryMocha's nit).

Credit: the fix is @skygunner's 29b0ea308, ported with Co-authored-by. @Edward4226 sent an independent patch of the same shape (0b8aee26f), and @MystryMocha verified it end to end with the real Mistral API and real Codex. Thank you all.

I'm leaving this open until the reporter confirms it works on v0.1.3125.

Confirmed working. I tested on v0.1.3148, which includes dd2be6565, rather than on v0.1.3125 itself.

Setup: real Codex (codex-cli 0.166.0) on `mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017`, effort `max`, over `/v1/responses`, against the real Mistral API.

- A short run with two separate shell tool calls: 3 requests, all 200, and the final answer was correct.
- A real coding task in one of my own projects: 48 requests over about 15 minutes, all served by `api.mistral.ai` with 200. About 36k reasoning tokens went through (up to 6.8k in one request), with context reaching about 208k tokens. No fallback to another provider and no 422 `extra_forbidden`.

Before the fix, the request after the first tool call failed.

Thanks @yetone, @skygunner and @Edward4226. This can be closed from my side.

Closing as completed.

Fixed in dd2be6565, released in v0.1.3125. I confirmed it on v0.1.3148 against the real Mistral API, using real Codex on `mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017` over `/v1/responses`. A short run and a 48-request coding task were all 200. There was no 422 `extra_forbidden` after the first tool call, and no request fell back to another provider. Details are in my comment above.

Thanks again @yetone, @skygunner and @Edward4226.

issue.title: mistral: a translated request (Claude Code) is refused 422 over reasoning_content in an earlier turn

repository.name: magpie
repository.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.

issue.body:
## What breaks

A conversation with an earlier assistant turn's thinking in it reaches Mistral as `reasoning_content`, which its chat API refuses for the whole request:

```
422 Unprocessable Entity: {"detail":[{"type":"extra_forbidden",
  "loc":["body","messages",2,"assistant","reasoning_content"],
  "msg":"Extra inputs are not permitted"}]}
```

This was hit on Claude Code (Anthropic Messages API) through `api.mistral.ai` with `deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017`. It reproduces on the built-in `mistral` provider, so it isn't the plugin's:

```sh
curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3425/v1/messages -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -H 'x-api-key: magpie' -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' -d '{"model":"mistral/deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017","max_tokens":64,"messages":[
  {"role":"user","content":"hi"},
  {"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"x"},{"type":"text","text":"ok"}]},
  {"role":"user","content":"say ok"}]}'
```

The same history on a relayed Chat request (`/v1/chat/completions`, `stream: true`) is 200, because `mistralThinking` runs there. A non-streaming Chat request to a plugin's provider is refused too (a plugin's account is always streamed upstream, so a non-streaming client request is translated).

Mistral takes an earlier turn's thinking as the typed part it returns — `[{"type":"thinking","thinking":[{"type":"text","text":"…"}]}]` — which `mistralThinking` already builds.

## Why

Two gaps, both in `internal/gateway`:

1. `mistralThinking` runs only on a relayed Chat request (`passthrough`). A translated request (`forwardTranslated`) never runs it, and Claude Code always needs a translation to a Chat-only vendor.
2. The check is `p.Preset == "mistral" || p.Host() == "api.mistral.ai"`. A plugin's `p.Host()` is `plugin://<id>`'s host, i.e. the plugin's id (`mistral-vibe`), so a plugin in front of `api.mistral.ai` isn't Mistral to it.

## A patch, if it's useful

`songlairui/magpie`, branch [`fix/mistral-thinking-translated`](https://github.com/songlairui/magpie/compare/main...songlairui:magpie:fix/mistral-thinking-translated) (one commit on `main`): it applies `mistralThinking` in `forwardTranslated`, and has `isMistral(p)` also read the base URL the plugin's provider says it sends to (`provider.PluginAPI()`, a new accessor). A test that fails without it, with the report's own `loc`:

```
--- FAIL: TestMistralThinkingTranslatedFromAnthropic (0.01s)
    mistral_translated_test.go:87: 422 after 1 calls: {"error":{"message":"Fake: 422
    Unprocessable Entity: {\"detail\":[{\"type\":\"extra_forbidden\",\"loc\":[\"body\",
    \"messages\",1,\"assistant\",\"reasoning_content\"],…}]}"}}
```

Verified: `go vet` on the two packages (and `GOOS=linux`/`GOOS=windows` vet with `-tags nogui`), `go test -tags nogui ./internal/provider` in a sandbox HOME (ok, 63.7s), and `go test ./internal/gateway -run 'Mistral|Reasoning|Thinking|Translated'`, 544 passed. `go test ./internal/gateway` in full: 3 failures, all pre-existing on a clean tree here (Go 1.27): `TestClaudeClientCacheAbsentUnchanged`, `TestMarshalRawIsEncodingJSON`, `TestMarshalSizedIsJSONMarshal`. The whole gateway package under a sandbox HOME did not finish in the time I had, so it's not claimed.

## One thing I'd leave out of that patch

`forwardTranslated` has no recovery for another vendor that refuses a thinking field in a message: the body is rebuilt from the request on each attempt, so dropping the field there needs the refusal remembered for the builder, as the relay path already does with `unfit`/`withoutRefused`. That's a change of its own.
